notes.title: FLASHOUT 3 IS NOW OUT!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello all FLASHOUT fans![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6106540/5c0dcc32c2114159e6b1479782654d88882756ec.gif[/img]

We are delighted to inform, that the third and most explosive entry to the FLASHOUT franchise, [b]FLASHOUT 3, is now live on Steam! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/d7497eacc9e2ee0940ca6cecd1972e25f07273a9.gif[/img]

With a campaign consisting of 10 tournaments, awesome and unique ships, great electronic music and last but not least - [b]VR, motion simulators and Steam Deck support![/b]

That's right, and you can grab your copy 10% off! Don't miss this chance and join the competition! We hope you will enjoy the new game :).

[b]Thank you for your support![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1761870

notes.title: FLASHOUT 3: Playable demo AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello all FLASHOUT fans![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6106540/5c0dcc32c2114159e6b1479782654d88882756ec.gif[/img]

[h3]Who is going to be the fastest???[/h3]

As promised, the playable [b]FLASHOUT 3 DEMO is now available for download[/b]! With online leaderboards, so you can join the competition and let's find out who is the fastest racer out there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6106540/35475072352a1c1b763332fc75947d2e4b3680d7.gif[/img]

[b]Features of the demo:[/b] 

One circuit (Star City), one ship and 3 types of weapon at your disposal! A full 3 laps race, with enemies and explosive action! 

The demo also features a dedicated music track that should pump blood into your veins! 

Hope you'll enjoy what we have prepared for you and stay tuned for much more FLASHOUT 3 news coming very soon (including videos from other circuits).

[h2]DEMO LINK:[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1985280

notes.title: FLASHOUT III Announced! Coming in 2022! Add to your wishlist!
notes.content:
[b]Hello all FLASHOUT fans! Today we have some great news to announce:

FLASHOUT is back and is racing into Steam this very year! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6106540/5c0dcc32c2114159e6b1479782654d88882756ec.gif[/img]

[h3]YEEES… FLASHOUT IS BACK![/h3]

Where high speed meets high stakes. Where unforgiving combat, loud electronic music and addictive boosts of adrenaline mix up to separate winners from losers. Where gravitation is nothing more than an empty word. This is where the world of [b]FLASHOUT 3[/b] will take you and your ride to the absolute limits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6106540/35475072352a1c1b763332fc75947d2e4b3680d7.gif[/img]

[b]FLASHOUT 3[/b] will offer you ultra-fast ships, loops, jumps and sudden razor-sharp turns! You will have the chance to test your racing skills on the most impressive sci-fi circuits and try not to fall behind! But if it happens, don't sweat! Unleash the power of rockets, guns, bombs and mines to help you level down your competition!

[previewyoutube=NiSL2s8E9Ig;full][/previewyoutube]
In [b]FLASHOUT 3[/b] you will take part in an exciting, head-to-head fight to the finish! Witness spectacular crashes, the agony of defeat, and the sweet taste of victory! But don't blink! It can all end in a flash!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6106540/6da6f2126bff8f236d9bfec883bca9ae3a5e39f5.gif[/img]

FLASHOUT was also always about music, so expect great and unique electronic tunes!

[b]Steam users can expect a playable demo version by the end of May! [/b]The full version of the game is coming later this year to PC (Windows, Mac, Linux)!

Make sure to wishlist the game!

[h2]WISHLIST NOW:[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1761870

[url=https://www.facebook.com/JujubeeGames]Follow JUJUBEE on Facebook[/url]

Til the next one!
